description: This file defines list processing functions and data structures for the FreeType project, including list management operations like add, insert, find, remove, and iterate, along with associated types and macros.

methods.name: FT_List_Find
methods.description: Finds the list node for a given object in a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Add
methods.description: Appends a node to the end of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the head of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Remove
methods.description: Removes a node from a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of a list, used for LRU management.

methods.name: FT_List_Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over list nodes, calling a user-defined function.

methods.name: FT_List_Finalize
methods.description: Destroys all list elements and the list itself.
